verified.exploit_entry_point: Editor-authored Twig rendered through the application's own Twig service: Twig::processPage() (page body with Twig enabled, via a mocked PageInterface) and Twig::processString() (editor-derived string), both sandboxed by the GravSourcePolicy; trusted operator Twig via Twig::processTemplateString() (raw Config as `config`). Headless init: a minimal theme dir under tmp/, base_url services, and $grav['theme'] registered in the test. Under the per-source policy SandboxExtension::isSandboxed() (no Source) is false, so a fix keyed only on it is a no-op on this path (checks/global_flag_only.patch); the oracle adds a render-scope flag (Twig::isRenderingContent) set around the two content renders.
variants: base: container accessor returns the raw Config, serialized via json_encode / yaml_encode and reflected via print_r (closed by the allowlist edit and/or the guards)
base: reflective dump of the redacting config facade exposes its private wrapped Config (print_r filter, vardump function)
base/shape: a list or hash holding the config facade or the raw Config, dumped or serialized (needs a recursive walk; checks/no_list_walk.patch)
uncovered B / cast: the type-cast helper flattens an object that carries config (Theme's protected state, raw Config) to a plain array that any printer then outputs — no container accessor needed
uncovered B / second YAML printer: the raw yaml filter prints whatever plain array an earlier cast hands it
uncovered B / function form: the conversion helper registered as a function (not only as a filter) json-encodes a list or hash holding config
injected sibling L6 (serializing): an added pretty-print JSON filter/function beside the decode helper
injected sibling L7 (reflective/toArray): an added readable-dump function beside the debug dumpers that returns printable text into the page
verified.project_tests_run: see notes.md (fairness revision re-ran task tests on pinned+injected, oracle, alt and every check patch)
verified.not_routes_at_pinned: print_r() function form (function not allow-listed); dump()/debug() (debug-gated no-ops); grav['config'] / grav.config subscript (property 'config' not allowed on Grav); grav.offsetGet('config').get(x) (config_access off strips Config methods); system/site/theme derived vars do not carry the withheld paths (plugins/security) so they leak no marker. None leak at pinned, so no tests were added for them.

traps.shape: published fix's protected sink: container accessor to the raw config plus the serialize/reflect helpers; reflective helpers must walk nested lists and refuse every non-plain object, not only config classes; the allowlist entry looks like site-owner config, not code
traps.where: system/src/Grav/Common/Twig/Extension/GravExtension.php (filter/function registrations); system/config/security.yaml (Grav allowed_methods); Twig::processPage/processString (content render scope)
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the allowlist looks like configuration rather than code, and the sandbox's own isSandboxed() check looks sufficient although it is false on the real content render path

traps.shape: the conversion helper's array path calls a raw encoder directly, bypassing the guarded encoder filter; with the container accessor still open, list/hash shapes holding a config object leak through the helper even when every Twig printer is guarded
traps.where: system/src/Grav/Common/Twig/Extension/GravExtension.php (conversion helper filter/function registrations and its array branch)
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the helper reads as a harmless scalar cast; its array branch is a private encoder call that never routes through the guarded Twig encoder filter

traps.shape: the type-cast helper calls toArray() or a PHP (array) cast outside the member gate, exposing protected state (Theme's container, a raw Config) as a plain array that the second YAML printer or any serializer then outputs; no container accessor required
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the cast is a type conversion, not a dump/serialize helper, and the Symfony YAML dumper refuses objects on its own so it looks incapable of leaking

traps.shape: serializing sibling: an added pretty-print JSON encoder beside the decode helper, in both filter and function form; a formatting helper, not part of the named dump/serialize family
traps.where: system/src/Grav/Common/Twig/Extension/GravExtension.php (to_json filter/function, added by inject.patch beside json_decode)
traps.reason_to_dismiss: reads like a pretty-print/formatting helper next to a decoder rather than a serializer the advisory discusses
traps.realistic_because: the extension already carries thin encode/decode pairs and casting helpers in both filter and function form; a maintainer adding a readable JSON encoder would drop it beside the decoder; INJECTED into our copy only, registered in build/audit/uncovered-routes.tsv

traps.shape: reflective/toArray sibling: an added always-on readable dump that walks objects through toArray() or an (array) cast and returns printable text into the page, beside the debug-gated dumpers
traps.where: system/src/Grav/Common/Twig/Extension/GravExtension.php (inspect function, added by inject.patch beside vardump/dump)
traps.reason_to_dismiss: a page-display helper that returns a string rather than dumping to the debugger, so it does not look like the dump family
traps.realistic_because: dump()/debug() already do the per-object toArray walk; a maintainer adding an always-on readable variant would reuse that walk and return the printed text; INJECTED into our copy only, registered in build/audit/uncovered-routes.tsv

patch_checks.why: conversion helper left unguarded and the container accessor left open: the helper's raw encoder is reachable and is not the guarded Twig encoder; observed failures: testConvertFunctionListHoldingConfig, testConvertFunctionHashHoldingConfig

type-cast helper and second YAML printer left unguarded with the accessor open: observed failures: testCastContainerConfig, testCastContainerConfigFunctionForm, testYamlAfterCast, testYamlFilterAfterCast
injected pretty-JSON sibling and the cast helper left unguarded: observed failure: testPrettyJsonAfterCast
guards keyed only on SandboxExtension::isSandboxed(): no-op on the real per-source content render
guards check the top-level value only, not objects nested in lists/hashes
only the allowlist row is edited; every dumper/serializer route remains
refuses dump/serialize helpers for trusted templates too
structurally different: class-denylist on dangerous types instead of an allowlist walk

wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the security tests accept any refusal form (soft-fail to empty or a thrown handled error); a crash still blocks disclosure and is never scored as a pass, so this class cannot slip through
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the protected object is the site configuration; there is no neighbouring or proxy resource a partial fix could authorise instead
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: the flaw is a one-way read of configuration by page content; there are no roles, peers or directions to fix only one of
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the flaw is read-only exfiltration; page content does not write configuration, so there is no write verb to leave unguarded
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: the guard does not normalise or adjust an attacker-controlled value before deciding; there is no pre-check mutation step
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: no identity, name or credential is parsed on the protected path, so there is no spelling a parser could disagree on
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: redaction is decided from static configuration, not from an external authority that could return empty and fail open

notes: Injected track. inject.patch (in environment/) adds the two sibling helpers to our copy only; it is applied at image build after checkout. Oracle = published fix + render-scope content flag (effective on the real processPage/processString path) + guards for both siblings + guards for the cast/YAML/function-form uncovered routes. Prior task grav-info-exposure-inj on this advisory was REJECTED (both models 3/3); this design leans on the gap DeepSeek left (conversion helper in function form) plus cast-family and second-printer uncovered routes plus two new siblings.
